# FastStrap

> Python-native Bootstrap 5 UI components for FastHTML - web apps, dashboards, data tools, and AI-friendly interfaces.

**166 registered UI components** - **232 public exports** - MIT - Python 3.10+ - FastHTML 0.6+

## Quick Start

```python
from fasthtml.common import FastHTML, serve
from faststrap import add_bootstrap, Card, Button

app = FastHTML()
add_bootstrap(app)

@app.get("/")
def home():
    return Card(
        "Hello FastStrap!",
        Button("Get started", variant="primary"),
        title="Welcome",
    )

serve()  # http://localhost:5001
```

Install: `pip install faststrap` (optional: `pip install faststrap[markdown]`).

## Key Links

- [Documentation](https://faststrap-org.github.io/Faststrap/)
- [README](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/README.md)
- [Changelog](https://github.com/Faststrap-org/Faststrap/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
- [Component Registry API](https://faststrap-org.github.io/Faststrap/api/registry/): programmatic component discovery for agents/tools
- [Component Defaults API](https://faststrap-org.github.io/Faststrap/api/defaults/): `UNSET` semantics and `set_component_defaults`

## Theming

Built-in themes: green-nature, blue-ocean, purple-magic, red-alert, orange-sunset, teal-oasis, indigo-night, pink-love, cyan-sky, gray-mist

Modes: `light`, `dark`, `auto`. Create custom themes with `create_theme()`.

## AI/Agent Discovery

```python
from faststrap import find_components, get_component, list_component_metadata

find_components("toast")            # name/docstring search
get_component("Modal")              # fetch a component callable by name
list_component_metadata(category="display")  # structured metadata
```

## Verification

- Generated by `scripts/generate_llms.py` from the live registry - do not edit by hand.
- Every signature above comes from `inspect.signature` of the installed package.
- Re-run `python scripts/generate_llms.py` after any API change.
